changelog: - **Closing the import wizard always starts the next one fresh, and its table no longer shows stale data.** Closing the spreadsheet import with Escape kept the half-finished tables for the next opening, while Cancel or a click outside threw them away; now every way of closing discards them. While the pasted text cannot be read, the wizard no longer shows the last table that could be read beside the error; once the text is fixed, the column roles you chose come back. And a group-by column that no longer applies — because the columns changed or a foreign key became another role — is cleared instead of blocking Next with no way to change it.
